query: Current pricing (as of February 2026) for Google Gemini API models: Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Gemini Embedding API
summary: Google Gemini API pricing in February 2026 ranges from $0.10-$2.50 per million input tokens depending on the model. Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite is the most affordable at $0.10/$0.40 per 1M tokens (input/output), while Gemini 2.5 Flash costs $0.30/$2.50 per 1M tokens. The Gemini Embedding model (gemini-embedding-001) costs $0.15 per 1M input tokens. Legacy text-embedding-004 was deprecated on January 14, 2026.

key_points: Standard API: $0.10 per 1M input tokens (text/image/video), $0.40 per 1M output tokens
Standard API audio input: $0.30 per 1M tokens
Batch API: 50% discount - $0.05 per 1M input tokens, $0.20 per 1M output tokens
Most affordable Gemini 2.5 model available
findings.details: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite is Google's lowest-cost 2.5 model, offering a 1 million-token context window. It supports controllable thinking budgets and includes features like Grounding with Google Search and Code Execution. The batch API provides a 50% cost reduction for asynchronous processing.

key_points: Standard API: $0.30 per 1M input tokens (text/image/video), $2.50 per 1M output tokens
Standard API audio input: $1.00 per 1M tokens
Batch API: $0.15 per 1M input tokens, $1.25 per 1M output tokens
3x more expensive than Flash-Lite for input, 6.25x more for output
findings.details: Gemini 2.5 Flash offers higher performance than Flash-Lite with the same 1M context window. The batch API provides 50% cost savings for non-time-sensitive workloads.

key_points: Model name: gemini-embedding-001 (current recommended model)
Standard API: $0.15 per 1M input tokens
Batch API: $0.075 per 1M input tokens (50% discount)
No output token costs for embedding models
findings.details: The Gemini Embedding model is the officially supported embedding solution as of February 2026. It replaced the legacy text-embedding-004 model which was deprecated on January 14, 2026. The model is available through both the Gemini API (ai.google.dev) and Vertex AI, though Vertex AI pricing differs significantly.

key_points: text-embedding-004 was deprecated on January 14, 2026
Migration to gemini-embedding-001 is required
Vertex AI pricing for text-embedding-004 was $25 per 1M tokens (before deprecation)
text-embedding-005 status unclear, but gemini-embedding-001 is the recommended path forward
findings.details: Google deprecated the text-embedding-004 model on January 14, 2026, replacing it with gemini-embedding-001. The legacy model was available through Vertex AI at $25 per million input tokens, making gemini-embedding-001 significantly more affordable at $0.15 per 1M tokens through the Gemini API. text-embedding-005 is mentioned in some documentation but gemini-embedding-001 is the official successor.

key_points: Google AI Studio offers free access to Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite
Lower rate limits apply to free tier
No monthly fee, no seat-based pricing
Suitable for testing and development
findings.details: Google provides completely free access to select models (including 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite) through Google AI Studio with a standard Google account. This free tier has lower rate limits but no billing requirements, making it ideal for prototyping and small-scale testing.

key_points: 50% cost reduction across all models
Available for asynchronous, non-time-sensitive workloads
Same 50% discount applies to both generation and embedding models
findings.details: Google offers a Batch API tier that provides 50% cost savings for all Gemini models. This is particularly valuable for embedding workloads where you can process large volumes of text asynchronously.
